# Tokenizer fixture notices

Whisper `vocab.json` and `added_tokens.json` come unchanged from [onnx-community/whisper-tiny at ff4177021cc41f7db950912b73ea4fdf7d01d8e7](https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-tiny/tree/ff4177021cc41f7db950912b73ea4fdf7d01d8e7). That repository identifies [OpenAI Whisper Tiny](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-tiny) as its base model. Whisper is [MIT licensed, copyright 2022 OpenAI](https://github.com/openai/whisper/blob/main/LICENSE); its notice is preserved in [whisper-LICENSE](whisper-LICENSE). These fixtures apply lossless gzip compression only.

Parakeet `vocab.txt` comes unchanged from [Ilya Stupakov's ONNX conversion of NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 at 8f23f0c03c8761650bdb5b40aaf3e40d2c15f1ce](https://huggingface.co/istupakov/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-onnx/tree/8f23f0c03c8761650bdb5b40aaf3e40d2c15f1ce). Its [pinned model card](https://huggingface.co/istupakov/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-onnx/blob/8f23f0c03c8761650bdb5b40aaf3e40d2c15f1ce/README.md) declares [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) and attributes the [NVIDIA base model](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3). The fixture applies lossless gzip compression only; no vocabulary content is changed. Recognition fixtures contain hashes and counts instead of sample transcript text. Tokenizer data remains development evidence and must not be added to installed packages.
